subject: Infra owners & evaluation timeline — Private deployment MAP
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: John Carter <john.carter@acme-analytics.com>; PlatformOps <platformops@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-14T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Infra owners & evaluation timeline — Private deployment MAP

Hi John / Acme team —

Thanks again for committing to a private deployment evaluation with Redwood. To keep this tight and to hit the close window you shared (targeting a late-Dec decision), I want to establish a short MAP focused on ownership and the eval milestones we discussed. Please see the proposed owners and timeline below and flag anything we should change.

Priority asks for this thread:
- Confirm the named owners for networking/VPN and KMS/IAM.
- Share the latest network diagram (attachment or Drive link).
- Agree to the evaluation milestones and a single weekly 30-min cadence.

Proposed owner list (Redwood / Acme):
- Networking & VPN: Marcus Lin (Redwood) / PlatformOps (Acme) — primary contact for VPN tunnels and peering.
- IAM & KMS: Karthik Iyer (Redwood) / John Carter (Acme) — responsible for key management, roles, and least-privilege policies.
- Deployment topology & ops runbook: Olga Petrov (Redwood) / PlatformOps (Acme) — runbook handoff, rollback plan.

Evaluation plan (high level):
- Week 0 (this week): Kickoff, exchange of topology + firewall lists.
- Week 1: Networking connectivity proof-of-traffic (VPN + IP allowlist) — smoke test.
- Week 2: IAM/KMS integration + encryption verification — sample keys and rotation test.
- Week 3: Performance eval (small load) + latency profiling.
- Week 4: Final QA, sign-off checklist, decision meeting.

Target close: dec-22-2027 (final decision). If timeline is aggressive for you, propose an alternate end date and we’ll update the MAP.

Attachments: redwood_private_map_template_v2.xlsx (MAP workbook) — please fill the owner column and return.

Can we take 30 minutes tomorrow at 11:00am PT for a short alignment call? If that works I’ll send a calendar invite with a concise agenda.

Thanks —

— Soojin
Soogin Lee
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: John Carter <john.carter@acme-analytics.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: PlatformOps <platformops@acme-analytics.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-14T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Infra owners & evaluation timeline — Private deployment MAP

Thanks, Soojin — appreciate the concise plan. A few quick notes from Acme:

- PlatformOps will take networking/VPN ownership. I’m looping them here (PlatformOps). They will confirm the VPN window and share the firewall list by EOD Monday.
- I’ll serve as the Acme IAM/KMS exec owner for approvals and MT (I’ll delegate engineering tasks to PlatformOps). For KMS we want a short verification that Redwood supports customer-managed CMEK; I assume that’s in scope.
- We attached the current network diagram (acme_network_topology_v1.drawio) and a SOC2 evidence bundle snapshot (acme_soc2_matrix.pdf) — non-sensitive subset.

We’re available tomorrow 11:00am PT for the 30-min sync.

John
John Carter
Head of Infrastructure, Acme Analytics
john.carter@acme-analytics.com | +1 (617) 555-0199

Attachments: acme_network_topology_v1.drawio, acme_soc2_matrix.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, PlatformOps <platformops@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, John Carter <john.carter@acme-analytics.com>
Date: 2027-11-15T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Infra owners & evaluation timeline — Private deployment MAP

Looping in a couple of practical notes from the Redwood infra side:

- VPN options: we prefer an IPsec tunnel for the initial eval (faster to stand up), but we can support AWS Transit Gateway peering if you want full routing. PlatformOps — can you confirm which you prefer?
- Firewall/egress: please provide a CIDR block list (management plane + inference egress) and expected ephemeral port ranges for testing.
- KMS: Karthik and I will coordinate on the CMEK flow. Karthik — I’ll hand off our CSR for the key policy test on Monday.

Operational ask: please populate the MAP workbook owner column and the first-iteration runbook tab with any required blackout windows. I’ll add our Red Team contact for the latency profiling.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: John Carter <john.carter@acme-analytics.com>; PlatformOps <platformops@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-16T14:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Infra owners & evaluation timeline — Private deployment MAP

Great — thanks everyone for the quick confirmations. Summary & next steps: 

1) Owners confirmed: PlatformOps (Acme) = Networking/VPN; John Carter = IAM/KMS exec owner; Marcus (Redwood) = Redwood VPN lead; Karthik (Redwood) = Redwood KMS lead; Olga (Redwood) = topology/runbook owner.

2) Deliverables (action owners):
- PlatformOps: firewall list + preferred VPN approach (IPsec vs TGW) — due 2027-11-15 EOD (if that slips, tell us the new ETA).
- Acme / John: confirm CMEK requirement + any KMS policy template — due 2027-11-17.
- Marcus/Redwood: draft VPN config & smoke-test checklist — due 2027-11-18.
- Karthik/Redwood: key policy CSR and rotation test plan — due 2027-11-19.
- Soojin/Redwood: send meeting invite for weekly cadence (30 min) and update MAP workbook.

3) Calendar: 30-min alignment tomorrow 11:00am PT — invite sent. We’ll use that slot to validate the topology and lock the Week 1 smoke tests.

If anything needs to move, flag in this thread. Otherwise I’ll treat the dates above as the MAP commitments and will convert them into the shared MAP workbook (Drive link) after our call. Looking forward to a smooth eval.

Best —

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments referenced: redwood_private_map_template_v2.xlsx
